name: gooey-input

frames.best_why: Shows the gooey liquid neck joining the icon circle to the expanded search field.

tagline: Search pills that split apart with a liquid neck and open into a field.
summary: A compact white search pill with a magnifier and placeholder. Clicking it springs open into a separate round icon button and a long input joined for a moment by a gooey bridge, then collapses again when left empty.
appearance: A single white pill sits on a black stage with a dark magnifier and the grey text Type to. Opened, it becomes a small white circle holding the magnifier plus a long white rounded field reading Type to search, with a thin liquid neck between them.
behaviour: Clicking the pill springs it open: the icon slides into its own circle while the field stretches right, briefly held together by a gooey bridge. Leaving an empty field collapses it and clears the text.
search_phrases: search box that expands when clicked
circle that turns into a text field
magnifier button that opens a box
morphing label and field on click
minimal search field for a dark page
search icon that stretches into input
use_when: A page has little room for search and wants a compact control that opens only on demand.
avoid_when: Fixed pixel widths and a detached offset, so it can overflow narrow containers.
customise: Placeholder, widths, offset, blur, value and open state are props, plus a classNames map per part; the icon and spring are fixed.
weight_why: A few nodes and one SVG filter; animation runs only on open and close.

a11y.note: The icon-only trigger has no aria-label, and the motion ignores reduced-motion preferences.

issues: Collapsed, the placeholder is clipped to Type to in frame 1.
The icon-only trigger button has no accessible name.
The fixed widths make the opened field long relative to the small circle.
polish_why: Liquid split is distinctive and smooth; the collapsed placeholder truncates awkwardly.
title: Gooey Input
